messages:
dom_sales: FYI - running a POC with MediSure. During their stress run they see lots of requests in Redwood console but Splunk shows many request events with missing span arrays. Also intermittent 429s when they ramp above 500rps. Can we triage?
anya_se: what export target & agent are they using? fluentd sidecar or our native exporter?
dom_sales: they started with native exporter -> Splunk HEC. agent shows entries but span_count=0 on many rows. sample request id they shared: req=ms-2024-09-12-0823, trace header they sent: x-request-id: ms-0823-abc123
kevin_eng: two suspects: header propagation or exporter backpressure. If x-request-id is present we should attach trace, but if sampling is low spans might be dropped before export. Any sampling override on their org?
anya_se: also check their Splunk HEC for throttling. If HEC returns 429 the exporter will exponential-backoff and eventually drop spans. Ask them to grep exporter logs for "hec http status=429" or "exporter_backpressure".
dom_sales: they pasted exporter logs: "WARN exporter: post /services/collector 429 rate_limited" and also a few "queue full, dropping spans" messages.
kevin_eng: there you go. We should recommend temporary measures: 1) bump our per-org RPS (short window) to avoid 429s originating from our throttles; 2) increase exporter buffer size and enable local disk buffering for HEC; 3) flip sampling to 100% for 20m so we can observe full span shapes. I can make the sampling change.
anya_se: please confirm whether their tests use long sequences (KV warmup) - first few requests sometimes omit detailed spans on cache miss. But queue full + 429 is primary.
kevin_eng: sampling set to 1.0 for org mediSure for 20m. ops_bot: observability: set_sampling(org=medisure, value=1.0, ttl=20m) by kevin_eng at 2024-09-12T08:30Z :white_check_mark:
ela_support: sending recommended fluentd snippet and env vars to customer now. include EXPORT_BUFFER_SIZE and DISK_BACKUP_DIR to avoid memory drops:
```
ENV EXPORT_TARGET=splunk
ENV EXPORT_HEC_URL=https://splunk.medisure.com:8088
ENV EXPORT_HEC_TOKEN=<REDACTED>
ENV EXPORT_BUFFER_SIZE=67108864
ENV EXPORT_DISK_BACKUP_DIR=/var/lib/redwood/export-buffer
```
ela_support: also asked them to run a quick curl against their HEC using the same token to verify ingestion: `curl -k -H "Authorization: Splunk <token>" https://splunk.medisure.com:8088/services/collector/event -d '{"event":"test"}'`
dom_sales: MediSure ops ran curl -> HEC accepted 200. But exporter still logs 429s during bursts.
kevin_eng: check network topology - if they front their HEC with load balancer with IP-rate quotas we might exceed per-IP HEC quota. If HEC returns 429s occasionally we'll see intermittent spans. Recommend they whitelist our exporter subnet or enable token-level throttling higher.
anya_se: short term we can create a routing override: per_org max_rps -> set to 900 for 2h to flatten spikes. Kevin, can you provision?
kevin_eng: done. routing-bot: updated per_org_override mediSure max_rps=900 until 2024-09-12T10:30Z (changed by kevin_eng).
dom_sales: they reran ramp and saw 429s drop to single digits and Splunk shows span arrays for most requests. They still noted occasional span_count=0 when a request was from a cold path.
ela_support: file follow-ups: 1) KB for customers: HEC sizing + exporter disk buffering snippet; 2) add trace header verification step into POC checklist (check x-redwood-trace / x-request-id present); 3) internal: add clearer logging line for queue drops containing org id and sample request id. I'll open tickets.
kevin_eng: opening GH issue: redwood/exporter#1045 - include org id in exporter_queue_full logs and emit a metric.
anya_se: billing question from MediSure: will sampling=1.0 increase charges? clarify: inference tokens still billed same; telemetry export/storage might have costs depending on retention plan. For the POC we can absorb telemetry ingestion for 48-72h.
dom_sales: MediSure accepted 72h telemetry coverage. They asked if we can document recommended HEC ingest capacity for production. I'll work with infra to produce a one-pager.
kevin_eng: closing notes - added temporary rate bump and sampling window, suggested EXPORT_BUFFER_SIZE + DISK_BACKUP_DIR to customer, and flagged exporter logs improvement. Good job team. :tada:
